d:
Bihar ke gaya jila mukhyalay se 75 kimi dur sthit imamganj prakhand ka bahera chuaabar ganv aaj samajik aur aarthik badlav ki misal ban chuka hai. 20 sal pahle tak yah ganv garibi, sansadhnon ki kami aur badhali ke lie jana jata tha.
